description: CUR-SEEK, variant: do long text keys collide in an index? Lk(ID, K TEXT(255)) with IX_LK holds K = 100 a + b (ID 1), 100 a + c (2), 250 a + 1 (3), 250 a + 2 (4), 254 a + z (5) and 255 a (6). From a new table-type recordset starting at the last row, Seek = for the keys of IDs 1, 3, 4 and 6; > and < for the key of ID 3; = and >= for the 250-a prefix; = for 254 a + y and > for 254 a + y; after each Errors, NoMatch and ID are read.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
